name: list-issues
description: Lists the issues of a GitHub repository, excluding pull requests, open by default, with each issue's number, which github__get-issue, github__update-issue and github__comment-on-issue-or-pull-request take. The repository's owner and name come from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

state.description: Which issues to list: open, closed or all.

perPage.description: How many issues per page, at most 100.
